QUOTE: **Buffers the engine will free must come from `entropic_alloc()`.** This applies to hook `modified_json` and any consumer string the engine takes ownership of.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the caller-to-engine rule (engine-freed buffers must come from entropic_alloc) and shows the Python side doing it in the hooks trampoline: "writes the JSON result with `entropic_alloc` and `ctypes.memmove`".
